summary: Iteration 7 (critical-safety auto_voice always-on) backend testing complete — 8/8 tests PASS. Verified: (1) single pendant press now sets auto_voice=true with severity='assist' and press_count=1 (previously auto_voice was false on singles); (2) second press within 60s escalates to severity='emergency' with press_count>=2 and auto_voice=true + 'Panic-press' message; (3) pendant fall event → severity='emergency' + auto_voice=true; (4) wearable press event → auto_voice=true severity='assist'; (5) wearable fall event → auto_voice=true severity='emergency'; (6) GET /api/kiosks/{central_id}/active-emergency returns the newly-created single-press alert (assist-level) because the query filters on auto_voice=true regardless of severity; (7) room-scoped kiosk also surfaces its own-room auto_voice alert via room/zone match. Frontend code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/Kiosk.jsx confirmed spec compliance: runVoiceLoop loops while voiceLoopRef.current && callStateRef.current !== 'idle', cancelCall flips voiceLoopRef.current=false + stops mediaRef, alert-resolved polling useEffect speaks 'A caregiver is with you now.' and calls cancelCall, kiosk-autovoice-banner + kiosk-voice-status data-testids present.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/pendants.py pendant_event — now always sets auto_voice=True and returns 200 even for non-press event_types (e.g. unknown strings). Since severity defaults to 'assist' for anything !=fall, a buggy bridge sending event_type='test' would silently create an assist alert with auto_voice=true and hijack the kiosk. Recommend explicit allowlist: if event_type not in {'press','fall','periodic_ping'}: return {'ok': True, 'alert': None}.

routes/pendants.py — the 60-second panic-press window uses count_documents on alerts.created_at as ISO string; iso-8601 strings compare correctly lexicographically only while on the same timezone & format. Safer to store a datetime field and query with a real BSON datetime. Current code works but is brittle to any future format drift.

routes/pendants.py — press_count is per-pendant but auto_voice is unconditionally True; if a resident holds the button down and the bridge fires 10 events in 10s, the kiosk active-emergency endpoint will keep returning the newest each 3s, potentially restarting the voice loop. Kiosk.jsx currently guards via handleIncomingEmergency only running when !alert, but a stale resolve + immediate new press could race. Consider debouncing at the backend (e.g., don't create a new alert if an unresolved one <60s old already exists for that pendant_id).
routes/wearables.py wearable_event — unlike pendants.py there is no dedup / rate limiting. A watch firing 'heart_rate_high' every 5s would flood alerts. Add same 60s-window check.

routes/kiosks.py active-emergency — 5-minute freshness cutoff is reasonable but if an alert is acked (status='acknowledged') it disappears from the endpoint (filter status='active'); confirm Kiosk.jsx cancelCall path is actually triggered on 'acknowledged' too — current useEffect only listens for 'resolved'.

Kiosk.jsx alert-resolved useEffect polls /api/alerts/{alert_id} every 4s — should also treat status='acknowledged' or 'closed' as exit, not only 'resolved', otherwise a nurse who acks without resolving leaves the loop running.

Kiosk.jsx listenOnce — if getUserMedia is denied or the tab is backgrounded, toast.error fires but runVoiceLoop will loop forever hitting the same error. Consider breaking the loop on repeated listenOnce returning null from a permission error vs a silent blob.
